scenes.basis: 8:1-9 the feeding continues at the sea (7:31) - "here in a deserted place" (8:4); no movement of Jesus
8:10 "he entered into the boat with his disciples, and came into the region of Dalmanutha"
8:13 "again entering into the boat, departed to the other side" - the landing place is unnamed
8:22 "He came to Bethsaida. They brought a blind man to him"
8:27 "Jesus went out, with his disciples, into the villages of Caesarea Philippi"
